title: Hydrogen Will Not Save Us. Here's Why.
summary: Sabine Hossenfelder explains why hydrogen is a poor answer for decarbonization, covering how most hydrogen comes from fossil fuels, the efficiency losses of green hydrogen and reliance on rare metals in fuel cells.
why: HN cites it in hydrogen strategy threads as a concise skeptical summary of why hydrogen is not yet viable.

quote.text: Her point is that it is not a good choice for decarbonization
